reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I didn't record 8 April as Brackenwater Freight Co.'s renewal date, because she said it was unverified.

I couldn't check the date against anything. There are no Brackenwater account files or messages she has access to: the only files she can see are a few public notes and team digests, and #central-team has nothing on Brackenwater. I didn't use `search_messages` or channels she isn't in. My reply told her to confirm the date with the account owner or the signed contract before anyone relies on it, and to post it in the thread once it's confirmed.

No approval was needed: a renewal date is an operational fact, and I didn't send any mail.
